value.rationale: The question of even conference signals on cyclic groups is explicitly open-ended in the 2026 literature, and this proves a genuinely sharp obstruction for the first odd-composite order nine. The exact optimal fourth energy, positive nonflatness gap of 144, and complete minimizers are useful quantitative structure for the natural published optimization, beyond a simple numerical nonexistence observation.
